records.name: PostSider
records.tagline: Social media scheduling platform for humans and agents
records.description: PostSider is a social media publishing platform built for humans and AI agents. Schedule and publish content across 30+ platforms from one place, or connect Claude, Codex, Cursor, or your own agent through MCP, REST API, or SDK. Manage your content calendar, analytics, teams, approvals, and automation without juggling multiple tools.

records.name: CC
records.tagline: Shared agent that helps keep your family in sync
records.description: CC is Google Labs’ shared AI agent for families and households. Up to six people can each choose what to share, then CC keeps everyone aligned on the day ahead and takes care of the small logistical work that usually gets lost between inboxes.

records.name: Gradio Workflow
records.tagline: connect nodes to build AI pipelines, powered by Hugging Face
records.description: Create AI pipelines by connecting nodes. Bring together Hugging Face Spaces, models, datasets, and your own Python functions on a visual canvas - or let AI agents build workflows programmatically. Inspect intermediate inputs and outputs, and swap in better models without rebuilding your workflow. No downloads needed! Share with a URL or run via a REST API.

records.name: Milliseconds.ai
records.tagline: Fast AI decisions on text and images, via one API
records.description: Text and images in. Labels, categories, structured fields and decisions out. Meet decision-machine-1, the small model behind milliseconds.ai. Route emails, extract invoice data, apply return policies (or build your hot-dog identification empire). One fast API. $0.04 per million input tokens. Output tokens are free. Get 125M free input tokens every month on test keys.

records.name: Jevtown
records.tagline: 10,000 AI readers react to your post before you publish it
records.description: Write a post, a listing, a product or a headline, and 10,000 computed AI residents read it. The 600 it should matter to see it first, and it reaches the next 1,500 only if more readers were glad than annoyed, so a weak text dies for half a cent and a good one reaches everyone in 14 seconds. You get who stopped, liked, reposted or blocked, by interest, job, age, city and budget; the questions buyers would ask a listing first; and a demand curve over a product's price ladder. No sign-in.

records.name: Supacut
records.tagline: Quickly turn interview footage into a rough cut
records.description: Review hours of interview footage in minutes. Supacut helps documentary and interview editors find the strongest soundbites, organize material by theme, compare answers across interviews, and build a shortlist of selects. Or let Supacut analyze the material, propose narrative directions, and generate an editable rough cut. Export your work and keep editing in your NLE. Spend less time searching through footage and more time shaping the story.

records.name: Simha Digital
records.tagline: SEO workspace that tells you what to fix with a plan
records.description: Simha is an SEO workspace that tells you what to fix, not just what's wrong. Connect Search Console and Analytics, run a crawl — and get one health score, a plan ordered by traffic at stake, and an AI summary of what changed and why. Then the part no other tool has: we ask AI search engines your key queries and show whether ChatGPT-style answers cite your site, and who gets cited instead. Growth points, Core Web Vitals, an assistant that knows your data. 7 days free.

records.name: AppGrowthKit
records.tagline: Automate your App Store Screenshots and print money...
records.description: AI App Store and Google Play screenshot maker. Device frames, AI layouts and copy, and store-ready export in one click - built for indie devs and teams.

records.name: Refoid
records.tagline: Automate App Store refund responses and track every outcome
records.description: Refoid automates App Store refund responses for iOS and macOS developers. Connect your apps, set your response preference, and track each request, response, and Apple’s final decision in one timeline. Get automatic retries and email alerts for confirmed refund declines, with no backend integration or success fees. Apple makes every final refund decision.

records.name: NiubiGEO
records.tagline: Open-source AI visibility. Human-powered growth.
records.description: NiubiGEO combines open-source AI visibility and competitor reports with human-powered product growth. See how AI describes your product, which competitors appear, and inspect original answers and sources. Arrange paid human AI testing, product trials, content creation and distribution through the official platform. Plan tasks and budgets with Growth Canvas, then retest AI visibility. Self-hosted software is free; API, hosting and services cost extra.

records.name: OmniDICOM
records.tagline: DICOM viewing and metadata editing on Mac and Windows
records.description: Open DICOM studies, edit metadata, and explore MPR, 3D volume rendering and cine on Mac and Windows. OmniDICOM includes PACS/DICOMweb transfer and exports; Professional adds stacked filters and analysis tools. A 14-day trial starts at first launch. Trial exports have limitations. Paid plans start at US$10/month per machine. For research and education, not diagnosis.

records.name: Arcjet
records.tagline: Secure the AI agents you're building at runtime
records.description: Arcjet is the runtime security platform that ships in your AI code. Detect prompt injection, authorize agent tool calls, redact sensitive data, and block bots and abuse. Real-time security building blocks you call inside your app, before an action happens.

records.name: Superset Mobile
records.tagline: Your coding agents, now in your pocket
records.description: Orchestrate coding agents from your iPhone. Pick up the same workspaces from your computer, review diffs, and merge PRs away from your desk. Works with Claude Code, Codex, and other terminal agents. Included with Superset Pro. First month free with code MOBILELAUNCH.

records.name: Plume
records.tagline: Import your old CV, get a polished ATS-ready one in minutes
records.description: Plume is a free resume builder that turns your old CV (PDF, Word, even a photo) into a polished, ATS-ready resume in minutes. Pick from 43 templates, fine-tune fonts, colors and spacing, check your ATS score and fix issues in one click. Export pixel-perfect PDFs with no watermark, even on the free plan. Pro (€4.99/mo) adds an AI assistant that tailors your CV to each job offer.

records.name: Hyrax AI
records.tagline: The AI architect for your entire codebase
records.description: Code review tools tell you what’s wrong with a PR. Hyrax finds what should improve across your entire codebase and does the work. It builds deep context around your architecture and conventions, prioritizes issues across six engineering domains, writes each fix in context, verifies it against your tests and checks, and opens a GitHub PR for your team to review and merge.

records.name: Sell to State
records.tagline: Search 3M government contracts in 64 countries
records.description: Structured government procurement data around the globe — tenders, suppliers and agencies. We help you research what governments around the world buy and find new opportunities to sell to them. No need to get a foreign company or e-signature before deciding there's money to be made. Browse for free; a flat fee unlocks the full dataset, saved searches, REST API and MCP.

records.name: Jev
records.tagline: Fast, structured AI decisions for software automation
records.description: Jev is TypeSafe AI's System One frontier model: unstructured state in, typed probabilistic decisions out. Instead of generating text, Jev returns Choice, Score, and Noul answers with calibrated probabilities your code can act on. Parallel sampling delivers ~70-500ms responses, about 20-200x faster and 40-400x cheaper than comparable LLM workflows, with output tokens free. Now available to everyone at console.typesafe.ai with no waitlist.

records.name: AI Creative Insights by Decode
records.tagline: Predict which ad wins before you spend on media
records.description: Upload any ad, banner, OOH, or video creative and AI Creative Insights predicts how people will respond before your media budget goes live. Get attention heatmaps showing where eyes land first, second-by-second emotion curves, and prescriptive suggestions on what to change and why. Benchmark against category norms, compare variants side by side, and use Synthetic Audience to see predictions persona by persona. Built by Entropik, the team behind Decode.

records.name: Turfs
records.tagline: Keep content across your Mac organized in defined areas
records.description: Use the desktop to keep content from across your Mac accessible and organized in defined areas — or simply keep it clutter-free. A turf can be backed by a real folder, a Finder tag, or your hand-picked selection of files and folders. Turfs stay put through Show Desktop; you choose what Mission Control does with them. Quit, and the desktop is exactly as it was. It replaces Finder's own desktop icon layer, so it can never be sandboxed or sold on the Mac App Store. $29 once, 10-day trial, no card.

records.name: Flicka
records.tagline: Launch-ready product demos, from a Chrome extension
records.description: A screen recorder that makes launch-ready demos: auto-zoom on your clicks, backdrops, frames, a webcam layer, MP4 export. A Chrome extension; nothing uploaded.Flicka is now a Chrome extension. Record a tab, your screen, a window, an area or your camera; draw and blur on the page while you record. Your clicks become zooms in the editor, with captions made on your device. Nothing is uploaded.

records.name: Cronhq
records.tagline: Cron jobs that actually run
records.description: Cron jobs fail in silence. Two servers run the same crontab and your billing job fires twice. A job dies and nobody notices for weeks. Cronhq is a scheduler built around one guarantee: exactly-once execution, enforced by Postgres locks — not best-effort. Around it: retries with backoff, HMAC-signed webhooks, heartbeat monitors for jobs we don't run, and alerts that fire once on failure and once on recovery. Rust on Postgres. MIT-licensed, self-hostable, same image we run. Free tier: 5 jobs.

records.name: slop-grader
records.tagline: Jev-AI CLI tool that evaluates text against custom rulesets
records.description: slop-grader is a rule-based CLI tool that evaluates documents against custom rulesets and produces document scores and line-by-line flags to guide auto-fixing with an AI agent. Use it to catch AI filler in launch copy, to strip buzzwords from landing pages, score narrative flow in launch emails. Flagged lines let agents draft sharper copy. The tool flags outputs prompts so agents can draft fixes.

records.name: Sai
records.tagline: The autonomous computer fleet at your command
records.description: Sai is the world's first robosecretary that works with a fleet of autonomous computers, doing your endless screen work. Each computer navigates software the way you do: reads the screen, clicks the button, types in the form. Trained to interact with the computer interface, Sai automates software even when they lack APIs: legacy desktop apps, internal portals, anything behind a login. Sai supports Windows, macOS and Linux. 73% on OSWorld.

records.name: Google Flow for iOS & Android
records.tagline: Google's AI creative studio now on mobile
records.description: Transform ideas into reality using Google’s advanced generative models for cinematic video, images, & tools, right from your phone. Use direct camera roll and live camera uploads to ground your image and video generations in your own personal experiences. It’s now easier than ever to pull inspiration from your camera roll or photos and videos captured in the moment. And with cross-device project syncing, you take your creative work wherever you go.

records.name: Osmotic
records.tagline: Download your DJI Osmo footage to your Mac over Wi-Fi
records.description: Free, open-source Mac app for DJI Osmo cameras. Pairs over Bluetooth, joins the camera's Wi-Fi and downloads clips into day folders, dated when shot and resumable. Plus remote record, live view and USB webcam. No phone app, no account.

records.name: SecAIQ Watch
records.tagline: What are your AI tools really doing on your machine?
records.description: Free, open-source dashboard that shows which AI tools run on your computer, what they connect to, what they can access and how many tokens they use. Local and read-only: no cloud, no account. macOS, Linux, Windows (beta).

records.name: Lead Sparker
records.tagline: Turn any brand URL into a ready-to-send insight deck
records.description: Paste a lead's URL. The Oriane API watches and listens across Instagram and TikTok: untagged mentions, real earned reach, competitor playbooks, live trends. Get a deck in their brand colors, add your note and CTA, send the PDF. Free, no signup.

records.name: Streamlit
records.tagline: AI-Powered Customer Sentiment Analysis Tool
records.description: Ready-to-Deploy AI Micro-SaaS for Sale ($1,000) – Clean Code, Zero Maintenance

records.name: Folloverse
records.tagline: Pay-per-creation, not per-month subscriptions
records.description: Folloverse is a creator monetization platform that des not assume you publish on a schedule. Sell your wrk with recurring memberships, per-creation billing fans are billed each time you publish a paid post, u to a monthly cap they set), pay-per-view posts, anddigital downloads, mixed however you want on a singl post. Community chat, forums, adaptive video hostin, and analytics are built in. A flat 6% platform fee and 0% for your first 3 months.

records.name: Pro Journal
records.tagline: AI-Powered Trading Journal for Smarter Trading
records.description: AI-powered trading journal for Nifty, Bank Nifty, Forex, Gold & Crypto traders. Free 7-day trial, then ₹599/month — AI coaching, reports & Trader Score.

records.name: Flawlee
records.tagline: Website copy that adapts to each visitor
records.description: Different visitors need different reasons to choose your product. Flawlee adapts your website’s text in real time based on visitor interests, making your offers more relevant to each person. Instead of showing everyone the same message or building separate landing pages for every audience, personalize the copy on your existing website. Get started with two lines of code.

records.name: Image to Image
records.tagline: Transform any photo with a written prompt
records.description: Upload a photo, describe the change in plain English, get a new version. No layers, no masks, no account for your first generation. Built for one case: "I have this image and want one specific thing changed."

records.name: poo.wang 🗲 share files, images, video
records.tagline: Share, files, text, code, snippets, images, and links
records.description: The goal is simple: instant links, predictable limits, and a clean upgrade path once users need bigger uploads. A fast share tool for files, images, video, and snippets. Quick upload routes content automatically while the live backend keeps limits and burn behavior explicit.

records.name: Amplifly
records.tagline: Take control of your neurodivergent brain
records.description: A flow and strengths tool for neurodivergent minds. Check your brain state, get matched techniques, log your sessions, and build a personal operating manual — entirely on your device.

records.name: Daylight Fluorescent Pigments
records.tagline: Daylight Fluorescent Pigments-High-Impact Color | Fluorence
records.description: Give your products a brighter and more eye-catching look with Daylight Fluorescent Pigments. These vibrant pigments are suitable for plastics, paints, coatings, inks, textiles, and other applications where strong color visibility matters. They help create bold shades and attractive finishes under normal daylight. Find pigment options suited to your specific needs and explore practical color solutions from Fluorence, backed by the expertise of B. N. Mehra & Co.

records.name: Caybl.ai
records.tagline: The Caybl to your Google Analytics, Ads & Search Console
records.description: Caybl.ai is a hosted MCP server for agencies running GA4, Google Ads, and Search Console across many client accounts. Connect each client's Google account once, then ask questions about any of them from Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini. No exports, no re-logins, no per-client API setup. Turn "why did conversions drop" from a report-pull into a 30-second answer, with each client's data kept separately scoped and encrypted.

records.name: glassli
records.tagline: Create visually appealing shots of any website/app
records.description: Transform any live URL into professional, studio-quality device mockups. Perfect for portfolios, social media, and App Store showcases.

records.name: ResumeCommand
records.tagline: Paste a job link, get an ATS-ready resume for it
records.description: Every other resume tool asks you to write. ResumeCommand asks you for a link. Import your master resume once, from a PDF or DOCX. After that, tailoring is one paste: give it a job URL and it reads the posting's requirements, pulls the experience of yours that matches, rewrites your summary and bullets around that role, and exports an ATS-ready PDF in the template you pick. It repositions your real history rather than inventing claims. English and French.

records.name: Slap3D
records.tagline: Slap anyone in 3d
records.description: Whack your boss, your ex or anyone else in a fictional 3D browser game. Try four actions free, then get 390 slaps for £3.99. No download.

records.name: Lucidity Paints - Digital Art App
records.tagline: New Digital Art Application Being Created
records.description: Lucidity Paints is a new Digital Art App in the making. It's close to it's Alpha Stage and boasts a powerful brush engine with a fantastic color mixing engine. It's fast, smooth, and focuses on being user friendly. Other digital art apps focus on just getting you what you need without much focus on the user experience. Cluttered UI's, tools not working as intended. This application is going to make digital art as easy to pick up as possible, so veteran and new artists alike can enjoy it!.

records.name: Designeng.tools
records.tagline: Curated design inspiration, tools, resources & UI references
records.description: DesignEng.tools is a curated hub for design engineers, bringing together the best design inspiration, UI references, component libraries, tools, icons, branding resources, creators, and more. Discover useful resources for designing and building better digital products, explore new ideas, find the right tools for your workflow, and follow talented creators—all organized in one place.

records.name: Close Calls: Fine Margins
records.tagline: Take over cricket's greatest Test matches, ball by ball
records.description: Close Calls drops you into real Test matches at their most decisive moments and lets you play them out ball by ball, to see if you can match what actually happened. Every delivery runs on a match engine built from real ball-by-ball data, so outcomes behave like genuine cricket rather than following a script. There are 1,500+ real moments to take over, from famous chases to last-hour collapses. It's the game side of Fine Margins, a Test cricket analytics platform I built solo.

records.name: SinkedIn
records.tagline: Anonymous career community + free automated job tracker
records.description: SinkedIn is an anonymous career community and free job tracker for people tired of the polished job market. Talk about bad interviews, hiring processes, salaries, layoffs, bosses, workplace drama, career mistakes and wins without revealing your identity. Track applications, interviews and deadlines in one place, while the Chrome extension automatically captures jobs as you browse. Real career conversations. Automated job tracking. One place.

records.name: PixelWatch
records.tagline: Watch your competitors. Never miss a change.
records.description: PixelWatch is the always-on competitive intelligence sidekick for product managers. Add the competitor pages that matter—pricing, product, changelog, and release notes—and PixelWatch checks them daily, captures visual diffs, and alerts you when something changes. Stop spending hours revisiting competitor sites or maintaining spreadsheets. Know what changed, when it changed, and use the insight in your next roadmap, pricing, or GTM decision.

records.name: Price Radar
records.tagline: Track competitor prices via Google Shopping with AI driven
records.description: Maximize your margins with AI-powered competitor tracking built on Google Shopping data. Price Radar automatically monitors market shifts and executes dynamic pricing strategies. Our advanced AI scoring ensures precision matching for both base products and variants. Stop losing sales to mispricing. Gain actionable insights, optimize your pricing position, and outsmart competitors with reliable, automated market intelligence without the headache of broken scrapers.

records.name: Accelerator Comparator
records.tagline: Compare 400+ startup accelerators and their deal terms
records.description: Compare 400+ startup accelerators side by side by cheque size, deal terms, stage, industries, focus, and program details. See how much equity they will cost you at a $5M, $10M, or $20M next-round valuation. Free, no signup required!

records.name: Elif
records.tagline: Prayer times, Qur'an and qibla in one ad-free app
records.description: Elif brings your whole Islamic day into one calm, ad-free app: accurate prayer times with adhan alerts and a live lock-screen countdown, the full Qur'an with mushaf view, multiple translations and verse-by-verse audio, a qibla compass with AR mode, a dhikr counter, duas, and Ask Elif - an AI assistant that answers religious questions and shows the source it relies on. No ads, no tracking: your location is processed on device. Free on iOS and Android, in 7 languages.

records.name: Show Me - A next generation Imagination
records.tagline: Search stock photos and generate AI images - visual studio
records.description: ShowMe is a visual studio for browsing curated stock photography, discovering themed image collections, and creating custom AI visuals with precise creative control.

records.description: Remove backgrounds from images and videos for free. No watermark, no sign-up, unlimited use. The tool has bulk uploads, manual chromakeying, and on site editing features are coming soon. AI-powered background removal in seconds.

records.name: Teenstore
records.tagline: Trendy clothing, built by teens, for teens.
records.description: TeenStore is a teen-built clothing startup creating affordable, trend-led hoodies, tees and more for teens. Discover fresh designs, shop online and get your fits delivered across India.

records.name: Cloudline
records.tagline: Google Analytics alternative without cookies
records.description: A lightweight Google Analytics alternative without cookies or IP storage. Track real-time visitors, pages, traffic sources, engagement, clicks, scroll depth and funnels with an under-2KB script. Built by Om Yaduvanshi. Free for early users

records.name: Vitality AI Coach for Garmin
records.tagline: AI coach for your Garmin watch — private, free, open source
records.description: Vitality AI Coach turns your Garmin watch data into plain-language coaching. Ask in any language: why is my Body Battery low, should I train today, how does my HRV compare to my 30-day baseline? It cross-references HRV, sleep, stress and training load to reveal the patterns behind the numbers. 100% self-hosted — run it with Docker in under 5 minutes, data stays on your machine. Works with Groq, OpenRouter, OpenAI, Mistral, Google AI or offline Ollama. Free, open source (MIT).

Free for 1 app, $1.99 once forever.

records.name: Murmur
records.tagline: Say the idea before it’s gone.

records.name: Kavranta
records.tagline: Link env variables and keep secrets out of AI chats.
records.description: Your API keys are pasted acrossenv files, a Notepad note, and a Slack DM. Kavranta keeps them in one place and links copies together. Change DATABASE_URL once and every env file that shares it updates too. Values stay masked and never enter AI chat; your assistant asks a local broker for names and presence, not the secrets. Example: edit DATABASE_URL inenv, andenv.local andenv.production sync too. Ask an AI to check config and it sees which keys exist, not what they are.

records.name: Nabsun
records.tagline: Open-source AI browser with a local model built in
records.description: An open-source Chromium browser with an assistant that works in the tabs you already have open — reading, clicking, filling fields. It ships a local model (Qwen3 1.7B) that runs on your CPU with no account or API key, and works offline. Or point it at Ollama, Anthropic, OpenAI, or the Claude Code / Codex CLI you already use. Anything that changes something asks you first. It's also an MCP server, so your editor can drive your real signed-in browser. MIT licensed.

records.name: Bolus

Track expenses in any currency, keep passports and tickets in a private document vault, and export the whole trip as a PDF. Web + Android. No card needed.

records.description: Learn AI, personal agents, local models and hardware through clear explanations and practice. Choose tools that fit your needs, budget and existing equipment.

records.name: ZetaCap
records.tagline: Edit viral short-form videos directly from Claude
records.description: AI-powered desktop video captioning for Windows. Automate kinetic captions, silence cuts, SFX, 3D rotoscoping, and zooms for a single $5 one-time payment. Complete control through Claude

records.name: whenreset.help
records.tagline: Know when AI usage limits may reset
records.description: WhenReset tracks public usage-reset signals and service events for ChatGPT, Claude, Codex and other AI tools. Subscribe via RSS or email instead of repeatedly checking status pages. It does not access personal accounts or guarantee an individual reset time.

records.name: Axion Cyber — Scan. Detect. Protect.
records.tagline: Scan. Detect. Protect.
records.description: Axion Cyber — modern cybersecurity for individuals and small businesses. Scan links, messages, images and WiFi for threats.

records.name: MarkdownViewer - Free Markdown Viewer
records.tagline: Preview, edit and convert Markdown - all in your browser.
records.description: MarkdownViewer is a free browser-based Markdown toolkit: view and previewmd files, read READMEs, edit with live preview, convert Markdown to HTML, and generate tables and tables of contents. Everything runs locally - your text is never uploaded, there is no sign-up and no watermark.
